title: salvia nemorosa subsp. pseudosylvestris
intro: Salvia nemorosa subsp. pseudosylvestris, commonly known as Woodland Sage or Purple Sage, is a subspecies of perennial herb in the sage family, native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as improved cognitive function, reduced inflammation, and enhanced immune system. The therapeutic actions of Salvia nemorosa subsp. pseudosylvestris include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
